Located at the holy feet of Tirumala Hills, a serene abode of luxury awaits the devout pilgrim - Marasa Sarovar Premiere. Uniquely designed and Inspired by the 10 Avtars of Lord Vishnu, it is the closest 5 star luxury hotel to the sacred temple. Combining spiritually uplifting aesthetics with architectural splendour, the hotel instantly connects with the soul. Elegantly appointed luxurious rooms & suites complete with refined modern amenities cocoon you in lavish splendour and offer spectacular views of the rolling Tirumala hills on one side and the hotel's picture-perfect water bodies on the other side. Two speciality restaurants with fine international cuisine and beverages delight your taste buds and senses. A fully-equipped health club, swimming pool, and a serene Buddha spa with special rejuvenation treatments pamper your personal fulfilment.

OUR EXOTIC RESTAURANTS

YOUR EVENT, OUR RESPONSIBILITY

Be it a grand wedding, a corporate event, or a simple meeting - our banquet halls in Tirupati are the right destination to host your events. Guests can choose from the 4 spacious banquet and conference halls for their events. The 2 banquet halls, together can host up to 400 guests and are ideal for large events. The other 2 board rooms are perfect for business meetings and conferences. The banqueting team at the hotel assists in planning, customising, and supervising any event from beginning to end. Menus for coffee breaks and meals can be customised according to your guests' nationalities and taste preferences.

Happiness @ Sarovar

Flexi Check In Check Out

We at Sarovar understand that your tight schedule does not accommodate time for strict formalities. Our flexible check in check out service lets you choose the duration of your stay making you always ready to be on the road. Your Happiness @ Sarovar is our greatest pride.

Chef Made my Breakfast My Way

The feeling of homeliness at any place comes with the warmth of the people around you and most importantly the food that you get there. At Sarovar we make sure that all your needs are met, our qualified chefs are always delighted to serve your favourite dish made as per your request. Your Happiness @ Sarovar is our greatest pride.

Take Away Breakfast With Early Check Out

The thoughtfulness of our staff is most visible with our take away breakfast service. We deeply care that you start your day with a sumptuous breakfast, however busy schedules often hinders our wish, so we offer a packaging service letting you carry your breakfast on the road. Your Happiness @ Sarovar is our greatest pride.

High-Speed Browsing At No Charge

Connectivity is the crux of the future and we at Sarovar are one step ahead. Our high-speed Wi-Fi ensures that your virtual personality never disappears. The Wi-Fi services are completely in the house. Enjoy your stay at the farthest destinations without being disconnected. Your Happiness @ Sarovar is our greatest pride.
